coverage_notes: The paper does not report a connector that maps biological representations into a language model; the language models are used as encoders feeding the VGAE/GIN. Encoder roles are inconsistent across sections: Results assigns amino-acid sequences to Sentence-BERT and functional descriptions to Galactica (sec_0005), while the ablation section assigns sequence embeddings to Galactica and functional annotation embeddings to Sentence-BERT (sec_0027). Fine-tuning or freezing status for the encoders and vocabulary extension are not stated. The paper also reports 75,010, 71,575, and 32,146/32,416 cell counts in different sections.
